text: The Vallent Driver (Japanese: , Varento Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive boss in . He is a Driver enemy fought at level 50 at the Artificial Blade Adjustment in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain alongside Gardyll and Zohak Drivers during the quest Eternal Spirit.
Vanny (Japanese: , Ivanisu) is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at Fonsa Myma Waters in the Kingdom of Uraya alongside Jaggra.

Valta Sovereigns (Japanese: , Varutā Roiyaru) are enemies in . They are Sovereigns that can be found at level 97-99 on Lv. 4, Megrez in the World Tree alongside a Grandum Sovereign and the Superboss Mk. VII Arek after the party reaches the First Low Orbit Station.
Vaio is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found on one of the middle levels of the Fonsa Myma Commercial District in the Kingdom of Uraya, next to his little brother Veero.
Veero is a young Urayan in . He can be found next to Sprintsy Sweets in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, standing next to his older brother Vaio.

Vasq's Recipe is an Info Item in . It is obtained from Vasq in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya after completing the Merc Mission Rainbow Shell and talking to him again after Indol sinks during Chapter 9. Once obtained, Pyra can cook Roast Meat Tagliata.

The Veg Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Nopon Cooking. It enables the purchase of Veg & Oyster Aspic from the Corcaja Greengrocers shop at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Unforgiving Terrain is a Heart-to-Heart in . It can be found east of the Jelidorend Highlands in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The two options to choose between are "I could lend out my salvager suits." and "Just gotta rough it out!". Viewing this Heart-to-Heart is required to unlock Dromarch's level 4 "Howl of Calm" Battle Skill.

Unreturnable Money is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province after completing the mission Beautiful Flower. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Dark Mastery", "Assassination" and "Leaping" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Round Up.
Varrea is an NPC in . She is a Leftherian who can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. She runs a shop called Tottet Trading.
Updraft is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).
Universal Beat is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).

Urbel is an NPC in . He is an Urayan man who sits on a crate at the top left of the Garfont Training Ground in the Kingdom of Uraya. He offers the Merc Mission Daily Training. He offers friendly advice on managing Blades to the party and supervises the training and exercises done by the younger mercs at the Training Ground.
Vargon is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found in the Fonsett Residential Area in the Leftherian Archipelago. He offers the Merc Mission Dringworm Hunting.

Vee is an NPC in . She is a young Urayan who can be found just outside the Mymoma Playhouse in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, where she hopes to act one day as her career. She is a friend of Iona and thus also knows Cole. Vee offers no quests or Merc Missions.

Upgrades and Tinkering is a DLC Quest in . It is one of five quests released as part of the New Quests Pack 2 of the Expansion Pass. After starting chapter 8, collecting the unlock item from the "Expansion Pass" menu, and Tora in the party, the quest can be received from him by examining the table inside his house in the Gormott Province. After starting this quest, several new Salvage Points become available.

The Unnamed Core Crystal is a Core Crystal in . It is received from Gramps during Chapter 2 and is the first Core Crystal used by Rex, acting as a tutorial to introduce the concept of Blade Resonance. When Rex resonates with it, he awakens a common Blade with Knuckle Claws and Wind element. The Blade awakened with this Core Crystal cannot be released. From the second playthrough onward, when Gramps gives the Unnamed Core Crystal to Rex again, the same Blade from the original playthrough is awakened, which means it will have carried on the same gender, stats, as well as any unlocked affinity levels and skills. The awakened Blade will even remark that they are glad to become part of the team a
Uthkine is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found in the Ayvill Shopping District of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He runs a shop called Larmogg Salvaging.
Utilizing the Elements is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Market of Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Unique Monsters R.I.P. is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from Darryth, the Informant in Fonsa Myma, for a base price of 1,100 G.

Unspoken Suspicion (Japanese: , Iwarenai Giwaku) is a Quest in . It can be received from Floren at the Gwenith Paddies in the Kingdom of Uraya after unlocking his level 5 Key Affinity and his level 4 "Beguiling Charms" and the Silver Pendant has been obtained. Completing this quest automatically activates his Blade Quest Nature Boy.

Vaugel Tirkins (Japanese: , Vageru Tākin) are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 26 - 30 in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during Chapter 4.

Uncid Sentries are unused enemies in . They are Sovereigns that would have been found at level 55 in the World Tree. While their data is still present in the game files, they were cut from the game release for unknown reasons.

Varshabore is an NPC in . He is an Indoline monk who can be found inside the Sanctum of the Indoline Praetorium. He is one of several NPCs who must be spoken to as part of the quest Indol's Teachings.
Vantya is an NPC in . She is an Urayan Driver who can be found in the Indoline Praetorium alongside her male Common Blade.

Vale's Weakness is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Alba Cavanich's Jakolo's Inn in the Empire of Mor Ardain after taking a rest at the Inn. It features a conversation between Vale, her Driver, Tora, Poppi α and Pyra.

Vattaud Riiks (Japanese: , Wonteddo Ratōru) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Riik family, and are fought at level 36 during the fifth wave of the Challenge Battle, Pest Control. This enemy drops no items.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Vanish Hoods (Japanese: , Banisshu Fūdo) are DLC accessories in . They increase the rate of aggro reduction from taking damage and aggro lowering effects by up to 37%. They are the upgraded version of the Beast Hood, Camo Hood and Skeleton Hood accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Undying Burwell (Japanese: , Fujimi no Buraddī) is a Challenge Battle Boss in . It is a member of the Tirkin family that is fought at level 110 during the final wave of the Challenge Battle Humanoid Alliance. This enemy drops no items.

Vanishing Sovereigns (Japanese: , Banishingu Roiyaru) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are Familion-type Sovereigns that are fought at level 98 during the Challenge Battle Mk. VIII. They primarily appear during wave 3, but can be summoned by the two Cavalier Sovereigns during the succeeding wave. The variants spawned by the Sovereigns have lower HP and drop less Ether Cubes, but much higher overall stats. This enemy drops no items.

The Unique Monster Subjugation Report is a feature in . It is added via the version 1.5.0 update of the game. It can be viewed by talking to the Battle Observer in Garfont Village, who allows the player to view records of defeated Unique Monsters found across Alrest. When viewed, it will display the names of the slain monsters, the amount of time or fastest time it took to defeat each one, and the area they reside in. It can be filtered by region and difficulty.

Vale's Weaving is a crafting station in at which Vale can create textile-type Pouch items from various Collectibles. It is located at Meske's house next to Future Crafts in Fonsett Village, Leftheria. It becomes available after unlocking the second level of her Affinity Chart (Trust rank B) and then speaking to Meske. This unlocks Vale's "Weaving" field skill. Her skill is raised to Lv.2 after she has made 10 items and reached Trust rank C, and to Lv.3 after another 40 items (50 total) and Trust rank B. Each skill level increases the selection of fabrics that she can make.
Valleria is an NPC in . She is an Urayan, and can be found by Volty Butchers in Fonsa Myma.

Urbs Armus (Japanese: , Urugusu Aruma) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Armu family and can be found at level 18-20 on Wrackham Moor in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Two must be defeated at level 24 for route A of What Matters Most, where they drop Armu Carcasses.

Valafum Hill (Japanese: , Varafumu no Oka) is a location in . It is located in the northern area of Gormott, just northwest of Singbreeze Bough. There is a large root nearby that provides access to the upper tiers of the northwestern area of Gormott, including the Depths of Ignorance and the Saints' Practice Grounds. A cave here which is in future known as Sauros's Bed contains a Treasure Trove and a green barrel containing Red Pollen Orbs.
Unforgettable Talismans are Talisman items in . They can be created by Haze at Campsites.
Unbreakable Talismans are Talisman items in . They can be created by Haze at Campsites.

The Vault Key is a Key Item in . It is the key to the Origo family vault located underneath Addam's manor at the Aletta: Militia Garrison. The party must retrieve it from the Behemoth's Roost during What Matters Most and deliver it to Vez.

Vabra Tirkin (Japanese: , Fabura Tākin) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 38-42 on the Saints' Practice Grounds of Gormott. During the quest Thicker than Water, one Vabra Tirkin chases Kali and Kelly towards the hole leading to the Grandarbor's Embrace, spawning at the end of the footprint tracks alongside a Grads Tirkin and a Keat Tirkin. Fighting them is optional.
Unforgotten Promise is a quest in . It can be received from Mireille near the Pischator Bridge in the Kingdom of Torna.

Vanadium Tirkins (Japanese: , Venatio Tākin) are quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 31 on Golden Twin Mesa in the Kingdom of Torna during the quest Armus Gone Astray alongside two Sorgus Tirkins. As with all quest exclusive enemies in , they drop no items, only gold.
Valak Corsages are light head armour in . They can only be worn by Melia and cannot be sold.
Valak Sandles are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected.

Vanguard Switch is a game battle mechanic exclusive to . It is similar to Blade Switch, but instead of changing the Blade that supports the Driver in battle, it swaps the positions and roles of the Driver and the Blade. This action is performed in battle by pressing the or D-Pad buttons. The character in the vanguard position is controlled directly by the player, while the one in the rear guard takes a supportive role in the background. This allows Blades to be fully playable characters. Each character has a separate set of arts that are available depending on the position. Vanguard Arts work exactly the same as Driver Arts, but are usable by both Driver and Blade. Rear Guard Arts replace th
Valak Bracelets are light arms armour in . They can only be worn by Melia and cannot be sold.
Valak Skirts are light legs Armour in . They can only be worn by Melia and cannot be sold.
Valak Sandals are light feet armour in . They can only be worn by Melia and cannot be sold.
Valak Tops are light torso armour in . They can only be worn by Melia and cannot be sold.
Union Sword (Japanese: ) is Rex and Pyra's Level IV Blade Special in if both Pyra and Nia are at Max Affinity in battle after the fight against Jin in Chapter 9.
Ursine Phantasm (Japanese: ) is Ursula's Level IV Blade Special in .
Unison Strike (Japanese: , Yunizonsutoraiku) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Noah's Ouroboros arts.
Uppercut Slash (Japanese: , Appāsurasshu, Lit. "Upper Slash") is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Heavy Guard class.
Variable Turret (Japanese: , Variaburutaretto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Heavy Guard class.

Ululas are enemies in . They are Agnian Levnises. One is fought at level 4 in Everblight Plain. Another one is fought as a Quest Exclusive Boss piloted by Salazar during The Ouroboros Experiment at level 46 at the Namba Mound in Dannagh Desert. A third one can be fought during A Deep-Seated Scar at level 61 near the First Ixia Bridge on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
The Urayan Trail (Japanese: , Invidia Yamamichi) is an Area in , located in the Pentelas Region.

Unobtrusive Liggy (Japanese: , Haimei no Regi) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 43 at Three Heroes Peak in Elaice Highway. The Underworld Rage Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class upon its defeat.
The Upper Water Supply (Japanese: , Kōsō Kyūsuiro) is a Rest Spot in . It is located on the fourth floor of Keves Castle.
The Urayan Tunnels, Entrance (Japanese: , Invidia Kōdō Shisetsu) is a Landmark in . It is located in Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region. It serves as the entrance into the Urayan Tunnels.

Unlimited Sword is one of Noah's unique Talent Arts in . This Talent Art can be used by Noah regardless of class and is unlocked during the battle against the Queen of Agnus. When used, an animation plays of Noah drawing Lucky Seven, during which he gains the Invincible buff. For the next 90 seconds, Noah fights with Lucky Seven, granting a special set of Arts whose effects are dependent on Noah's current role, as well as allowing him to inflict Doom while in an Attacker's class. When the Archsage's Gauntlet is tackled on the Hard difficulty, Noah will be unable to use Unlimited Sword or Lucky Seven arts unless the Lucky Seven License is obtained.

Unruffled Narrah (Japanese: , Onkō no Nara) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Armu family, and can be found at level 19 in the Fornis Region, at Laprel Knoll near Shikashaka Mesa in Ribbi Flats. The Defense Time Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class upon its defeat.

Vapid Roger (Japanese: , Kyoei no Raja) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Droid, and can be found at level 70 at the Hangar Zone in the Origin Interior. It forms the quartet "Hollow Ones" with Artificial Optho, Dishonest Karom and Phony Temnos. The Berserker Mindset Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Upper Drainage (Japanese: , Kōsō Haisuiro) is a Location in . It is located on the fourth floor of Keves Castle, accessed from the Throne Room.
Unwavering Resolve (Japanese: , Utsurowanu Omoi) is a Hero Quest in , dedicated to Isurd.
Vandham's Heir (Japanese: , Vandamu wo Tsugu Mono) is a Hero Quest in , dedicated to Monica.

The Valley of Anguish (Japanese: , Hitan no Tani) is a Location in . It is located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region. It is accessed from Elsayer Cape. The Unique Monster Joyful Nimroog can be found here.
Usherines are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Varran Bunnits are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 44 on Everblight Plain. One is also fought at level 75 during the fifth wave of the Challenge Battle Arts and Crafts.
Varran Hoxes are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Hox family, and can be found at level 41-42 on Elaice Highway.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Varicinis are Mushroom Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region in .They can also be purchased from the Colony 11 Caravan, or produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation. They can be found in Yesterdale in . Four are needed for the Yesterdale Collectopaedia. They can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).
Utility Gloves are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region, or via the Fabricator at Perimeter Outlet in the Cadensia Region after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Vagrant Jades are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Urchon Fossils are Fossil Collectible items in and . They are fossilized Urchons. In , they can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. In , they can be found on the Aurora Shelf.

Ultramarine Ant Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in Swordmarch. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation. They are fossilized Ultramarine Ants from Galahad Fortress.
Ulula Metal Fists are items in . They can be dropped by any Ulula type Levnis.
Uzraif Ropl are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 53-54 at Farlaine Underpass in Erythia Sea.
Vastclaw Crustips are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 55-58 at Farview Cape, Cape Arcaphor, and Lavi Sandbar in Erythia Sea.
Varmeen Blants are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Blant family, and can be found at level 50 at Farview Cape in Erythia Sea during Going Home.
Varmeen Medoozes are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family, and can be found at level 50 at Farview Cape in Erythia Sea during Going Home.
Umber Drague is a Boss in . It is a member of the Drague family, and is fought at level 30 at Great Cotte Falls in the Pentelas Region.
The Valley Caravan is a shop in . It is a shop run by a Traderpon at the Forward Post Camp in Alfeto Valley. It sells Ether Cylinders for 10000 G.
Url's Special Fertilizer is a Key Item in . It is received from Url during Reasons to Evolve.
Uor Scorpoxes are Normal Enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family, and can be found at level 38-39 on Hovering Reef 5 of the Syra Hovering Reefs.

Vampiric Rush is a Time Attack Challenge Battle in . It can be received from Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the second part of the Expansion Pass. This challenge takes place at Great Cotte Falls. Clearing this challenge with at least an A rank for the first time will unlock the Swimwear A outfit for Lanz.

Vampire Bat is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Defiled Ishtar while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Unity is a mechanic in . Three pairs of party members team up to grant access to their respective Unity Combos and Unity Skills. It is unlocked during the fight against the Ritteli Rhinon. Initially, the only pairings available are Matthew with A, Nikol with Glimmer and Shulk with Rex. After defeating the first boss in Chapter 3, the Unity option in the menu can be used to create new pairings.
Vanishing End is one of A's Talent Arts in . It can only be used while Vision is currently active.
Veggie Soup Recipe is a Key Item in . It allows the party to cook Chunky Veggie Soup at Rest Spots. It is obtained upon completing Elevator Repairs.
The Unbroken Pillar is a DLC level in . It is located in the Land of Challenge and serves as the main hub for Challenge Battle Mode.
The Unidentified Skell (Slate) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in . It is a Skell that is fought at level 21 at Barbarich Desert in Oblivia during The Qlurian Archaeologist.

Unknown Scholastics is a Holofigure in . It depicts a female mannequin wearing the complete Neil's Bodywear series. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Affinity Mission The Qlurian Archaeologist.
Upper Qmoevas are two Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are Qmoevas fought at level 53 at the Lakeview Stronghold in Noctilum during Chapter 13 (Act 2).

Untamed Eyepieces I are light head armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2000 for the first time with Shulk in the Score Attack course Caterpile Circuit. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2,500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Eyepieces II are light head armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Shulk for the first time on the Battle Race course Twilight Speedway. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3,800 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Jackets I are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2200 for the first time with Shulk in the Score Attack course Jungle Rumble. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4200 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Jackets II are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Shulk for the first time on the Battle Race course Midnight Forest. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 6300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Arms II are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Shulk for the first time on the Battle Race course Alcamoth at Dawn. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2400 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Arms I are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2400 for the first time with Shulk in the Score Attack course Alcamoth Orbital. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 1600 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Bottoms II are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Shulk for the first time on the Battle Race course Blizzard Rally. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Bottoms I are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2600 for the first time with Shulk in the Score Attack course Valak Slalom. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Shoes II are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Shulk for the first time on the Battle Race course Colony 9 Wild Ride. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.

Untamed Shoes I are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2800 for the first time with Shulk in the Score Attack course Rural Road. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3000 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Shulk.
Vandham's Other Ask is a quest in . It can be received after completing Vandham's Last Wish. This quest introduces the player to the Merc Assault mode.
Uyghen is an NPC in . He is an Urayan soldier who can be found at the Gwendle Repair Dock outside of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The V-Knuckle is an spare weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Puge enemies.

Unfathomable Facades are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found from a Strange Petrified Tree on the Northern Searoad in Sylvalum, which requires the Biological Field-Skill to be at level 4.

Venomous Lizards (Japanese: , Esepoizuntokage) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they have shiny bodies, but people avoid them because they look like venomous lizards. Five are required for Collection Quest 4 in Frontier Village.

Wallslide Gwynry (Japanese: , Kabegiwa no Guenrī) is a Unique Monster in . It can be found at level 9 in the Mag Mell Ruins of Tephra Cave. It is located at the dead end east from the intersection north of Escape Pod Bay then south at the next intersection. Defeating this enemy is required for completing the Colony 9's Challenge 4 quest.
Vengeful Daulton (Japanese: , Seisai no Dōruton) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Upa family, and can be found at level 22 east from Test Pit 4 in the Ether Mine.

Venaes Nebulae (Japanese: , Penaesu Nebura) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 34 near various waterfalls in Makna Forest, or in place of the Caris Nebula if it is raining. Venaes Nebulae disappear altogether if a heat wave is occurring. Defeating one of them is required to complete the Frontier Village's quest Monster Quest 1 - Part 3.

Visions (Japanese: ) are gameplay mechanics in . Using the Monado, Shulk is able to predict the future, a skill that is activated when a monster is going to use a battle art that will incapacitate or heavily injure the party member that currently holds the aggro of the monster. Avoiding incapacitation, debuffs, or damage in general can be performed though the use of a Monado skill, passing aggro to another party member, inflicting Topple upon the enemy or another of the multiple alternatives. It is possible to have a vision even when Shulk is not in the active party. When a vision tag is broken, the music changes to Visions of the Future. Visions are most commonly seen against red or yellow
Voltak (Japanese: , Vorutekku) is a Machina in . He can be found on the top floor of the Junks in the Hidden Machina Village.

Vronik (Japanese: , Beronika, Veronica) is a Machina in Xenoblade Chronicles. She is Orkatix's mother, and can be found from 06:00 to 15:00 in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm, just inside the main entrance.
Vol'aren (Japanese: , Borario) is a High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. He is the father of Cian and Atael. He can be found east from the Fountain of Hope in Alcamoth, past the escalator.

Verdant Eternities (Japanese: , Shinryoku no Tokoshie) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Colony 6. According to their description, Shulk took a while to name them and they are leaves that never wither.

Walnut Grapes (Japanese: , Kurumi Gurēpu) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they are grapes in a hard shell that are too bitter to eat even if someone manages to crack them. Four are required for Ingredients For A Brew B route.

Venom Platypuses (Japanese: , Dokunokamonohashi) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, they are black-furred venomous platypuses that happily swim in poisoned swamps.

Verdant Bluchal (Japanese: , Shinryoku no Burukkuru) is potentially the first Unique Monster encountered in . It is a member of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 5 on the beach just south of Anti-Air Battery 1 or north of the Main Entrance to Colony 9. Defeating this enemy is required for completing the quest Challenge 2.

Vilia Lake (Japanese: , Viria-ko) is a landmark in . It is a large lake located on the first floor of Tephra Cave. South of the large lake is an Ether Crystal deposit containing HP Up I and Poison Defence I.

Warrior's Diadems (Japanese: , Tatakaumono no Kanmuri) are light head armour in . Although classified as light, they share the same icon and appearance as Eryth Gear and Stellar Gear, both of which are medium head armour.

Viliera Hill (Japanese: , Biriera Kyūryō) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg. It is located roughly in the middle of the map, between Raguel Lake and Kamos Guidepost. North of it is the Sky Stage and south is Kisk Cave. It is a hill, but not a normal hill, for the party can walk under it. Therefore, it is similar to an elevated walkway. The walkway splits in two in the middle, and the two parts meet back up on the other side. Underneath the hill there are some Volff and a couple of Mount Tortas. There are a few Unique Monsters around the area as well, some required for quests (such as the Violent Andante, required for Challenge 1 - Part 1). Armoured Rockwell a

Volffs (Japanese: , Vorufu) are a species of enemy in the . They are similar in appearance to a wolf. Volffs undergo minor appearance changes between games; their manes are longer and colored differently in and , but otherwise they are very similar to the original designs in .
Warm Gloves are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are favoured by Assault Troopers, although it is unknown who the troopers are.

Vidian (Japanese: , Bibian, Vivian) is a High Entia in . She can be found far southwest of the Imperial Palace on the road at the western edge of the map, standing directly across from the southernmost escalator, from 06:00 to 18:00. After the events at the Mechonis Core, she is trapped in Whitewing Palace. Once she is rescued, she will move to the Ether Plant in Eryth Sea.

The Volff Lair (Japanese: , Vorufu no Negura) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg, south of the third bridge in Gaur Plain. It is filled with Volff, especially at night, and an Ether Deposit can be found here.

War Swing (Japanese: , Wōsuingu) is one of Reyn's physical arts in . Reyn spins, hitting all nearby enemies 4 times each. Each successful hit fills his Talent Gauge by 10%. In , Nene has an identical version of this art called Feather Swing.

Warrior Arms are heavy arms armour in . They were developed during the last war between Bionis and Mechonis for the troops on the front lines. They are not dropped by any enemies, but are available for sale or trade.
War Blades (Japanese: , Wōburēdo) are weapons in . They are twin blades wielded by Fiora.
Verdigris (Japanese: , Berudeguri) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are gunlances wielded by Reyn. They can only be obtained from various high-level enemies, mostly in Colony 6

Vilae Arachnos (Japanese: , Birae Supaido) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 93-96 in a spider room north of Heavenly Window landmark. They are also found along the path to the Arachno Queen's Nest and the Arachno Feeding Lair. Compared to Panasowa Arachno, they are much bigger in size (just like Jadals Arachno). They can drop the Arachno Sickles needed for Friendship Tokens.

The Village Entrance (Japanese: , Saihate-mura Iriguchi) is a landmark in . It is located in Makna Forest. It is the entrance to the Nopon village, Frontier Village, and it is accessible by crossing through a series of hanging bridges.

Vidian Rescue Mission (Japanese: , Bibian Kyūshutsu Sakusen) is a Surprise Quest in . It is triggered after five Aora Telethia have been defeated during the Frontier Village quest Restoring the Capital, and after the events at the Mechonis Core. The objectives involve two quests Broken Ether Furnace and Broken Ether Furnace 2 given by Kaleka in Frontier Village, they must be completed first in order to finish this quest.

Warehouse 2 (Japanese: , Dai 2 Sagen Sōko) is a location in . It is located in Tephra Cave. It is a part of the Mag Mell Ruins. It is on the way to the Cylinder Hangar in Colony 9. Looking carefully at the back portion of the warehouse will reveal a closed off doorway. Behind it is actually the Hidden Warehouse.

Vicious Rhanas (Japanese: , Mōshū no Rāna) are five quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Rhana family, and can be found at level 73 under the bridge south from the Central Plaza in Colony 9 during Getting to Know Minnie. Each drops a Thick Rhana Hide, which is needed for A Token of Friendship.

Veteran Yozel (Japanese: , Rōrenna Yōzeru) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Feris family, and can be found at level 83 at night during dense fog, in the area northeast of the Silent Obelisk landmark in the Satorl Marsh. It appears together with a pack of three level 79 Green Feris. It must be defeated to complete Satorl Marsh's Challenge quest, which becomes available after the events at Mechonis Core. It can drop the Lucky Fang needed for Replica Monado 1.

Vivid Anstan (Japanese: , Senretsu no Ansutan) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Licorne-type member of the Telethia family, and can be found at level 75 near the middle of the Third Lung in Bionis' Interior. It is quite large, iridescent, and fairly easy to spot. The Mystical Klesida can also be found nearby. Vivid Anstan can drop a slotted version of the Rex Cuisses and Loki Drones.

Victorious Gross (Japanese: , Gokō no Gurōsu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Selua family, and can be found at level 73 at Pars Sympathica Tower in the Bionis' Interior. It drops the Steel Selua Cell needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Venerable Focalor (Japanese: , Senshū no Fokaroru, Millenium Focalor) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 64 on the Training Ground Roof in the Central Factory. It must be defeated to complete the Roof Battle surprise quest. It can drop the Reinforced Thrusters needed for A Weapon Just For Me.

Violent Andante (Japanese: , Bōsō no Andante) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ardun family, and can be found at level 16 on Gaur Plain. It must be defeated to complete Bionis' Leg's Challenge 1 - Part 2. It is located somewhat close to Raguel Lake, north of the eastern exit from Kisk Cave, and can be either north or south of Viliera Hill.

Veritas Glyphs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Superbosses. Veritas Glyphs are otherwise unavailable. According to their description, the truth of everything is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

The Verification Devices are four control panels in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are located in Agniratha, at the tops of the Calcos, Helas, Dios, and Cleas Pillars. They must be activated to complete the Story Quest Pillar Verification Devices.
The Venous Plexus (Japanese: , Mōjōmyaku Chitai) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Interior. The Officer Robusto can be found here.
The Vein Crossroad (Japanese: , Jōmyaku no Kōsaro) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of the Bionis' Interior, and can be accessed by taking the left path at the Spinal Nerve Tower.

Volkampf, the Pursuer (Japanese: , Tsuigeki no Borukanfu) is a Story Exclusive Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Cinicula family. It is fought at level 5 at FN Site 116 in the East Gate Plain of Primordia during Chapter 2 in order to access the FrontierNav Site.

Verus is a Light Type based Skell unit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is also known as Wels in the Japanese version. Verus is one of the Skells produced by BLADE in New Los Angeles. It is the favourite Skell of Elma. Its vehicle form is a sort of futuristic armed motorcycle. The level 60 upgrade of this Skell is the Verus Cain.

Visions of the Future (未来視発動, Vision Reacts) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 3 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard in battle after a vision warning. If that vision changes or is broken in any way, then this theme will play, alerting the player that the future has changed. This music will then continue to play throughout the remainder of that particular fight. However, this music will not play if the battle theme is "Engage the Enemy", "A Tragic Decision", "Zanza the Divine", or "The God-Slaying Sword".
Vortex is one of Bozé's two Signature Arts in . It is a Melee Art. Cross can learn this after completing the Affinity Mission Bozé's Way.

Vice Simius (Japanese: , Vaisu Shimiusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Simius and can be found at level 34-40 at Big Arch or North Coast in Oblivia. One must be defeated during The Duel (Part I).
Vorpall, the Sickle-Fanged (Japanese: , Kamakiba no Vōparu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can be found at level 54 in Sylvalum, in Banshee Cave.

Vera is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Initially, she can be found near the Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. After Chapter 5, she can be found on the Deck of the Ma-non Ship during the day. She is a member of the Prospectors Division.

Volcannon Ciniculas (Japanese: , Borukanon Vasaruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cinicula family, and can be found at level 58-59 in Cauldros, near FN Site 506 or Titan's Table.

Violet Forfexes (Japanese: , Viore Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 10 along the edge of the falls near FN Site 205 in Noctilum.
Viridian Forfexes (Japanese: , Bijiria Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 22 in Noctilum at FN Site 218.

Wandering Ovis (Japanese: , Toraberā Owisu, Traveller Ovis) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ovis family, and can be found at level 35-40 on Delusians North Summit and the trail leading up to it in Sylvalum. They will disappear if spore cloud weather sets in.
Victory Rock (Japanese: , Vikutorī Rokku) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, north of East Ibra Ravine and west of Sea Whisper Valley.

Walter (Japanese: , Worutā, English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at the entrance to the Hangar in the Administrative District. He is responsible for issuing Skell Licenses for those who pass the License Certification Test. He is a member of the Curators Division.

Viridian Saltats (Japanese: , Birijia Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 22 at Janpath Lake, and at level 28-30 at Biahno Hills, Plundered Ruin and Stickstone Rise in Primordia.
Victoria (Japanese: , Vikutoria) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found near Central Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Vermilion Insidias (Japanese: , Bāmirion Parako) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Insidia family, and can be found at level 46-49 in Noctilum, near Fukai Pass.

Warlord Ictuses (Japanese: , Bushou Manda) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ictus family, and can be found at level 38-39 in Cauldros, around the Abandoned Bivouac. Defeating six of them is required to complete the basic mission Ictus Infestation (Warlord).

The Vita (Japanese: , Wīta) is a Ganglion Skell and a Main Boss in . It is Luxaar's personal Skell. It is fought at level 50 in the Lifehold Core's Interior during Chapter 12. During the second round, seven Mechanoid bosses assist the Vita: the Enhancer, Link, Pursuit Alpha, Pursuit Beta, Pursuit Gamma, Shield, and Strike Satellises. If enough time elapses, the Vita can resummon these bosses. Only the Vita is registered in the Enemy Index, none of its Satellises will be registered (except the Sentinel Satellis later). After the completion of Chapter 12, it can be fought again in the Time Attack Mission Dark Matter Phantom. However it must be fought with ground gear, as Skells are not allowed
Vespers (Japanese: , Usuperu) are bat-like creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They come in two color variants, brown and red.

Visigels (Japanese: , Narukī) are jellyfish-like Piscinoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Four limber, blade-tipped tentacles protrude from their bodies. Visigels can be found in Sylvalum and Cauldros.

Viridian Germivores (Japanese: , Birijia Burōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 22-25 at Sea Whisper Valley in Oblivia, near the oasis.
Vigents (Japanese: , Pekkā) are huge rocky ape-like quadrupedal creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are similar to Viragos.
Wang (Japanese: , Wan, English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Vitriol Cesspool (Japanese: , Dokudō Sendō) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located in Noctilum. This area is accessible from FN Site 209 by going east then turning left after arriving at the nearby poisonous water lakes. The Vitriol Cesspool's main feature is a lake of poisonous water that saps 75 HP per second; this can be reduced by Terrain Damage Reducer Augments. Past the poisonous water lies an open area with various treasures guarded by hidden Ghillie Falsaxums. Jejebba and Arsenican can be found here during The Mad Monk and The Voltant Visionary respectively. The Squad Mission Contamination Nation also takes place here. A tunnel in the lake leads through a secret p

Warawa (Japanese: , Warawa) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found north of East Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. She collects Miralife cards and is desperate to acquire a super-rare gold card by trading with other collectors in New LA.

Walolo is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at East Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. He permanently relocates to Drongo Caravan in Cauldros after My Angel, My Lana is completed.

Villainous Caecuses (Japanese: , Viran Doren) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caecus family, and can be found at level 41-42 or at level 48-49 in the North Hardheart Canyon or at FN Site 402 in Sylvalum. Defeating five of them is required during the mission Culling Caecuses.
War Emperor Qmoevas (Japanese: , Wōenperā Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 41-50 at O'rrh Sim Keep in Cauldros.
Wainess Fossils (Japanese: , Weinesu no Kaseki) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Warbones (Japanese: , Wōbōn) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular near FN Site 322. Six are needed for Preparations for War.

Voltant Scanners (Japanese: , Borutanto Sāchā) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, especially around O'rrh Sim Castle. Three are needed for A Scanner Scheme.
Vesper Fangs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vespers in Primordia.
Vesper Hair Clips are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vespers in Primordia.
Veven (Japanese: , Veven) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at the Professor B's Lab in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. He is the assistant of Professor B.
Vesper Fries are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vespers.
Veverta is an NPC in and . She can be found near North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

Violet Cervuses (Japanese: , Viore Keruusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cervus family, and can be found at level 60 at Great Washington Isle in Oblivia at nighttime.

Viridian Monoceros (Japanese: , Birijia Unikoru) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Monoceros family, and can be found at level 34-37 at West Ciel Sandsea and the Shivering Sands in Sylvalum.

Volcannon Monoceros (Japanese: , Borukanon Unikoru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Monoceros family, and can be found at level 52-53 in Cauldros east of Bestial Utopia.

Vittorio, the Battle-Scarred (Japanese: , Kogō no Vittorio) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Tectinsula family. It can be found hidden at level 28 in Oblivia southwest of River Isle and northwest of Barbarich Desert. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Vittorio, the Battle-Scarred.

Vilem, the Gold-Scaled (Japanese: , Kinrin no Virēmu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Aetrygon family. It can be found at level 45 in Oblivia in southeastern Lake Basel (it hides underwater until approached). Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Vilem, the Gold-Scaled. It must be defeated for Squad Mission No.15.

Vendura, the Spellbinder (Japanese: , Kowaku no Vendura) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Cavern Clan Prone and can be found at level 20 in Oblivia at Mesa Fortress, on a raised ledge southeast of FN Site 303 during the day.
, a Virago]] Viragos (Japanese: , Toruto) are huge quadrupedal creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are similar to Vigents, but with more pointed heads and multiple eyes.

Vivohasts (Japanese: , Borunte) are Insectoid creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look like big mantises or stick insects. They can be found in Noctilum and Sylvalum. They are counterparts of Thalluses.

WR512: Urdu (Japanese: , WR512: Urudu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Definian and a Ganglion. She can be found at level 62 at the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros at any time except late night, in front of a group of Milsaadi Savages.

Vendura's Galdr (Japanese: , Vendura Sen'yō Garudora) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Galdr machine. It can be found at level 50 at Scabland Fortress in Oblivia during nighttime. It is the Galdr of Vendura, the Spellbinder, a Prone soldier found during the day. Defeating Vendura's Galdr is required for Squad Mission No. 10.

Volcannon Vigents (Japanese: , Borukanon Pekkā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vigent family, and can be found at level 55 at the Emerian Battlegrounds (emerges from the lava pit), at level 63 west of Dragonbone Promontory, at level 58 at the Capital Wreckage, and at level 61 at FN Site 512 in Kitsune Stronghold in Cauldros.

Volcannon Tersquals (Japanese: , Borukanon Rakenma) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Tersqual family, and can be found at level 52 in the lava field between Sunset Falls and Tengu's Playground and at level 58 northwest of Dragonbone Promontory in Cauldros.

Violet Germivores (Japanese: , Viore Burōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found hidden at level 7 in Noctilum northwest of Seabound Coil Tree near Coil Tree Cape, on a projection that overlooks the waterfall.

Volcannon Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Borukanon Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family, and can be found at level 41 at the watering hole at Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros during the day.

The Verus Cain is a Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the level 60 version of the Verus Skell, and becomes available after completing Chapter 12. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.
Vibrant Plumes are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Saltats. Two are needed during A Tip of the Cap.

The Warm Angel Halo is a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It has the same appearance on all characters, and shares this appearance with the Soothing Angel Halo and Supreme Angel Halo. It can only be obtained from a Treasure Box in Sylvalum, north of the Cleansing Spring.
Wanana is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the night.

Vigil Forfexes (Japanese: , Vijiru Pagurusu) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are level 34 members of the Forfex family, and can be found on Northpointe Beach in Primordia. Four of them must be defeated during the Normal Mission The Good Thief.
Vulcan Barrager Zigs (Japanese: , Barukanbaretto Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 32-38 in Sylvalum, at Hilal Stronghold.
Vyponne is a Ma-non NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the day.
Vi Sezha (Japanese: , Bi Seza) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia.

War Kaizer Qmoevas (Japanese: , Wōkaizā Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 51 at Anvil Sandplain below Anvil Rock Two and at level 63 near Luxaar's Xern in Sylvalum.
Vulcan Gunner Zigs (Japanese: , Barukankyanon Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 44 northwest of FN Site 415 in Sylvalum.

Vulcan Launcher Zigs (Japanese: , Barukanranchā Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 60 atop various rock formations on the northern side of Sylvalum, near FN Site 405 or FN Site 405, as well as guarding the entrance from Seabird's Beak.
Wall Decals are decorations in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be displayed around BLADE Barracks to liven it up. As Cross's BLADE Level increases, he or she gets access to more varieties of decals.
Vigent Bloods are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vigents. A vial of Vigent Blood is needed for Child of Mira.
Vio Penga is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the day.
|-|Normal = |-|Worn = |-|Advanced = Vivid Suits are Skell Wear torso armor in and . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are a part of the Vivid armor range.
|-|Normal = |-|Worn = |-|Advanced = Vivid Helmets are Skell Wear head armor in and . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are part of the Vivid armor range.
Visigel Waterfall Orbs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from blue Visigels.
Viscous Humour is a common material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Papils, Tectinsulas, and Arenatects. Four are needed to complete Mayday.
Voltant is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is retrieved from Hugo during one route of The Good Thief.

Wanted: Miranium Expert is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Go Sirho and the primary destination is the Commercial District in New Los Angeles. It leads into Wrothian Innovation, though accepting it is not a prerequisite.
The Voltaic-Tusk is a superweapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Vivohast Crescent Hooks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vivohasts. Two of them are needed for the related mission Partners in Prototyping.

Virago Alloy Plates are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from orange Viragos, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components of Ranged: TP Gain Up and Custom.WP-R-GP augments.
Virago Blood Sweat are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Viragos, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Vigent A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a red vigent variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Barnabas, the Despot in Oblivia.
Vigent B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue vigent variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Goliath, the Stronghold in Sylvalum.
Vigent C is a Holofigure in . It depicts a black vigent variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Vainamo, the Bellower in Cauldros.
Virago A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts an orange virago variant. It can be obtained from Buchwald, the Guardian in Noctilum.
Virago B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a purple virago variant. It can be obtained from Behemoth, the Netherdweller in Sylvalum.
Vesper A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a brown vesper variant. It can be obtained from Necro, the Cavelord in Primordia.
Vesper B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red vesper variant. It can be obtained from Froste, the Courteous in Noctilum.
Visigel A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue visigel variant. It can be obtained from Yune, the Ambusher in Sylvalum.
Visigel B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black visigel variant. It can be obtained from Poppy, the Pyromaniac in Cauldros.
Visions of Beauty is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the twins Lara Mara and Lara Nara. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Waste Not, Want Not.
Visions of War is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Tree Clan and Cavern Clan Prone. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Tree-mendous.

Visions of Peace is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the Tree Clan Prone Nimu Turton and the Cavern Clan Prone Slovity Pagus. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission An Ancient Legend.

Wandering Grexes is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.1, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting fourteen Forfexes. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Vivohasts on the Move is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.15, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting five Dobromila, the Alluring. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Warm Cat Ears are casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They have the same appearance on all characters, and share their appearance with the Soft Cat Ears. They can only be found in a Treasure Box in Oblivia, on the ridge west on Mount Edge Peak.

View to a Drill is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and allows a large amount of Credits and Miranium to be earned quickly. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Visual Cloaking is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that reduces the field of view of sight-detection enemies. The Skell equivalent is Cloak.SIGHT.

Virus is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Virus renders those afflicted by it unable to use ranged Auto-Attacks and Battle Arts for the duration of the debuff. It also prevents the use of non-ranged Battle Arts that utilize the wielder's ranged weapon, such as Assault Hammer, Enhanced Stand, Subterfuge, or Ghostwalker.
Vehicle.APPEND-DEF is a Skell frame special augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces appendage damage by 10% to 50% when in Skell vehicle mode.
Vehicle.FRAME-DEF is a Skell frame special augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces primary damage by 5% to 25% when in Skell vehicle mode.
Vehicle.DEBUFF-RES is a Skell frame special augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It Increases resistance to all debuffs by 5% to 25% when in Skell vehicle mode.
